critique.evidence: All three screenshots show a cohesive, polished dark technical aesthetic: restrained grid texture, crisp white hierarchy, muted blue-gray body copy, cyan structural accents, and semantically distinct green/yellow/red highlights. The oversized desktop headline scales cleanly into tablet and mobile layouts; the evidence card reorganizes without clipping, overlap, or broken alignment. Borders, labels, monospace metadata, generous spacing, and the full-width mobile CTA feel deliberate and demo-ready. Minor weaknesses remain: the desktop composition leaves substantial inactive space on the right, the tablet card’s upper section feels slightly sparse, and the tiny all-caps footer copy is visually weak at tablet/mobile sizes.
critique.fix: Refine wide-screen balance by giving the explanatory artifact block a clearer alignment relationship to the hero or card, slightly tighten the tablet card’s vertical spacing, and increase footer text size/line-height on smaller viewports while preserving the restrained hierarchy.
